designSystem.styleGuidelines:
## Brand & Style
The brand personality is disciplined, articulate, and architecturally grounded. Designed for modern professional teams, it balances corporate utility with high-end editorial calm. The interface removes ambient distractions, unnecessary gamification, and saturated accents to elevate clear written communication and intentional dialogue.

The aesthetic merges **Minimalism** with **Modern Editorial Restraint**:
- Deep obsidian anchors contrasting with delicate, warm alabaster surfaces.
- Strictly no synthetic gradients, playful illustrations, or emoji-heavy UI ornamentation.
- Structural layout integrity driven by razor-thin hairline boundaries and deliberate, spacious typographic hierarchy.
- Thin-line visual iconography (1px to 1.25px stroke weights) communicating utility with quiet confidence.

## Layout & Spacing
The layout leverages a disciplined fluid grid anchored inside structured containment modules.

- **Desktop (1024px+):** 12-column architecture featuring a persistent channel/thread hierarchy; 24px gutters and 36px outer margin.
- **Tablet (768px - 1023px):** 8-column layout with 20px gutters and 24px margins, transitioning auxiliary sidebars into collapsable drawers.
- **Mobile (< 768px):** Single-column stacked canvas with 16px margins (`1rem`) and unified vertical spacing rhythm.
- **Rhythm Rules:** All layout margins, padding blocks, and gaps resolve to increments of 4px and 8px. Component density stays open and calm; chat bubbles and post modules use ample inner padding (`space-md` to `space-lg`) to maintain editorial elegance.

## Elevation & Depth
Elevation in this design system is strictly achieved through surface contrast and crisp 1px hairline boundaries—never through drop shadows or blurred ambient glows.

- **Level 0 (Canvas):** Tone `#FCFAF6`. Ground level containing main scroll areas and backdrop regions.
- **Level 1 (Cards & Message Bubbles):** Crisp pure white `#FFFFFF` bounded by a 1px solid `#E7E3DC` hairline border. No drop shadow.
- **Level 2 (Inverted Anchor / Hero Module):** Solid `#09090B` blocks anchored at top viewports or global navigation panels, featuring distinct rounded bottom corners (`24px` to `28px`).
- **Level 3 (Overlays & Dialogs):** `#FFFFFF` surfaces with a 1px solid `#09090B` crisp contour, paired with a solid `#09090B` backdrop at 20% opacity without blur filters.

## Components

### Top Hero Panel
- **Background:** Solid `#09090B` with white `#FFFFFF` text.
- **Geometry:** Square top corners against the window frame; bottom corners rounded to `24px` (mobile) or `32px` (desktop).
- **Contents:** Channel names, contextual team status, and search trigger. Icon buttons inside use thin 1px white strokes.

### Buttons
- **Primary:** Solid `#09090B` background, full pill silhouette (`9999px` radius), pure white text, zero border. Active state: `#27272A`.
- **Secondary:** Pure white `#FFFFFF` background, full pill silhouette, `#09090B` text, wrapped in a 1px hairline border of `#09090B`. Active state: subtle `#F4F2EB` fill.
- **Tertiary / Ghost:** Transparent background, `#71717A` label, shifting to `#09090B` on hover/focus.

### Cards & Chat Containers
- **Surface:** Pure white `#FFFFFF`.
- **Border:** 1px hairline `#E7E3DC`.
- **Radius:** `18px` to `20px`.
- **Padding:** `1.25rem` (`20px`) on mobile; `1.5rem` (`24px`) on desktop.
- **Divider Lines:** 1px solid `#F4F2EB` internally between replies or metadata strips.

### Input Fields & Chat Composer
- **Resting:** Pure white `#FFFFFF` background, 1px `#E7E3DC` hairline border, `14px` border radius, text in `#09090B`, placeholder in `#71717A`.
- **Focus:** 1px solid `#09090B` border with zero outline ring.
- **Composer Controls:** Monoline action icons (send, attach, format) rendered in `#71717A` with a 1.25px stroke weight. Primary send action leverages a compact black pill button.

### Chips & Channel Filters
- **Pill Geometry:** Height of 32px with full pill radius.
- **Resting:** `#FFFFFF` background with 1px `#E7E3DC` border, `#71717A` label.
- **Active / Selected:** `#09090B` background, `#FFFFFF` text, no outline.

### Checkboxes & Radios
- **Checkboxes:** 18px square with 4px corner radius. Unchecked: 1px `#E7E3DC` border. Checked: solid `#09090B` fill with a crisp white checkmark icon (1.25px stroke).
- **Radio Buttons:** 18px circle. Checked: Solid `#09090B` rim with an inner centered 6px dot in `#09090B`.

### Lists & Activity Rows
- **Layout:** Edge-to-edge within cards or canvas columns.
- **Dividers:** Optional 1px hairline `#E7E3DC`.
- **Typographic Pairings:** Item headline in `#09090B` (`body-md` semibold), supporting details and timestamps in `#71717A` (`label-md`).
- **Selection State:** Subtle tonal fill of `#F6F4EE` across the row radius.

screens.prompt:
Brand: 'Talk It Out'. Screen: the Groups tab for a brand-new user with no groups yet.
Device: Mobile (390px wide).
Visual Style: Bold monochrome aesthetic. 
Canvas background color: light cream (#FCFAF6).
Font: Inter, clean tracking and typography hierarchy.
Icons: Thin line icons (Phosphor style), strokes around 1.5px. Strictly no gradients, no purple, no emoji.

Page structure:
1. Top Hero Header:
- Solid black hero header block (#09090B) with rounded bottom corners (rounded-b-3xl / 28px).
- Large white title "Groups" in bold clean Inter.
- In the top right corner of the header, include a subtle profile icon (thin line circle user avatar in white stroke/circle button).
- Generous padding inside header, high contrast white-on-black typography.

2. Empty State Main Content (on #FCFAF6 cream background):
- An elegant, calm empty state presentation.
- Top icon: A refined thin line group/chat bubble icon (Phosphor style) inside a subtle circular border or clean icon badge.
- Heading: "Your first group" (font-bold text-xl or 22px text-[#09090B]).
- Subtitle: "Groups are where your team talks it out. Join one with an invite link or start your own." (text-sm text-[#71717A], centered, relaxed line height).

3. Two Large Choice Cards (stacked vertically, 18-20px corner radius):
- Primary filled black card:
  * Title: "Join with an invite link" (white text, bold, font-semibold)
  * Subtitle: "Paste a link from your team" (white text with slight opacity / #D4D4D8, text-xs/sm)
  * Background: solid black (#09090B), rounded-[20px], padding p-5, with an arrow or right-chevron icon in thin white stroke.
- Secondary outlined white card:
  * Title: "Start a group" (near-black text #09090B, bold, font-semibold)
  * Subtitle: "For a team, project or retro; you become its controller" (secondary text #71717A, text-xs/sm)
  * Background: pure white (#FFFFFF), rounded-[20px], hairline border 1px solid #E7E3DC, padding p-5, with an arrow or plus icon in thin line stroke.

4. Slim Text Link:
- Directly under the cards: "Or explore community questions" (text-xs or text-sm, text-[#71717A] hover:text-[#09090B], underline or subtle hover, centered).

5. Quiet 'How it works' strip:
- Subtle header/label: "HOW IT WORKS" in small uppercase tracking-wider text-[#A1A1AA] (10-11px).
- Three-item horizontal strip (or vertical clean list card) on a subtle white/hairline card or clean row with 3 columns:
  * Item 1: Thin line icon (incognito / eye-slash / mask or pen) + label "Anonymous if you want"
  * Item 2: Thin line icon (sliders / sound wave / spark / tone) + label "AI calms the tone"
  * Item 3: Thin line icon (shield / check / user-check) + label "Controller reviews first"
- All icons thin monochrome line style, text is tiny, quiet, and legible (11-12px, font-medium text-[#71717A]).

Hard constraints:
- NO floating action button.
- NO upgrade banner.
- NO purple, NO gradients, NO emojis.
- Cards have 18-20px radius and hairline border #E7E3DC.
- Fits seamlessly inside the mobile shell frame with the bottom navigation bar active on Groups.

outputComponents.text:
Here is the initial empty-state **Groups** tab for **Talk It Out**, crafted strictly to your specifications:

### Design Details:
- **Palette & Atmosphere:** Warm light cream canvas (`#FCFAF6`) paired with bold, crisp contrast elements in pure black (`#09090B`), stark white (`#FFFFFF`), hairline borders (`#E7E3DC`), and muted secondary gray text (`#71717A`). Zero purple, zero gradients, zero emojis.
- **Top Hero Header:** Bold black header with smoothly curved bottom corners, a prominent white title ("Groups"), and an understated user profile outline icon in the top right.
- **Calm Empty State:** Features a minimal line icon, the heading **"Your first group"**, and the descriptive guidance copy.
- **Two Choice Cards:**
  1. **Join with an invite link** — Filled black primary card with white copy and action arrow.
  2. **Start a group** — Clean white secondary card with a 1px hairline border (`#E7E3DC`) and subtle icon.
- **Explore Link:** Minimal centered link reading *"Or explore community questions"*.
- **"How It Works" Strip:** A quiet, three-pillar overview highlighting *Anonymous if you want*, *AI calms the tone*, and *Controller reviews first* with fine-line Phosphor-style icons.
- **Navigation:** Persistent bottom tab bar with the **Groups** tab highlighted as a clean black pill.

Let me know what you would like to explore next!
